1.content: S denotes the agent's starting position; G denotes the goal cell; H denotes impassable obstacles (walls); F denotes free traversable cells with no intrinsic reward.

2.content: Free cells (F) yield zero immediate reward; the goal cell (G) yields a reward of 1 upon entry and ends the episode.

3.content: The agent may move to any orthogonally adjacent cell that is not an impassable obstacle (H). Moves are deterministic and always succeed when the target cell is free (F) or the goal (G).

4.content: Obstacle (H) and free (F) cell types are static; cell symbols do not change during an episode.

5.content: The arrangement of obstacle (H) and free (F) cells remains unchanged during an episode; the agent never observes a cell changing type.

6.content: The agent has full observability of the entire grid each step, seeing the type of every cell (S, G, H, F) without hidden information.

7.content: There is no per-step penalty; each move yields zero reward unless the goal cell is entered, which provides a reward of 1 and terminates the episode.
